class.name: NetwWebRTCSignaler
class.brief_description: The rendezvous a game subclasses so a WebRTC session exchanges SDP and ICE over signaling it chooses.

method.name: _close
method.description: Releases the signaling transport. Called when the session closes, and by a signaler's own wind-down after the native link is up.

method.name: _local_signaler_id
method.description: Returns this peer's own address on the signaling transport. Returns an empty [String] when the signaler has no address of its own, which is the stock behaviour.

method.name: _on_session_connected
method.description: Reports that the native WebRTC link to [param peer_id] is open, so a signaler that costs something to keep alive may wind itself down. Overriding this is optional; the stock behaviour keeps signaling up until the session closes.

method.name: _open
method.description: Opens signaling for [param room_id] as [param local_peer_id]. A host is always id 1 and may be given an empty [param room_id], which means the signaler generates one and returns it from [method _room_id]. Returning anything but [constant @GlobalScope.OK] fails the bring-up with that code.

method.name: _poll
method.description: Drives the signaling transport for one frame. Everything a signaler reports upward is reported from here or from [method _open].

method.name: _room_id
method.description: Returns the room this signaler opened, normalized or generated during [method _open]. This is the address a joiner is given, so it must be readable by a person if a person is expected to pass it along.

method.name: _send
method.description: Carries [param payload] of [param kind] toward [param to_peer_id]. [param to_address] is that peer's own signaling address when the session has learned it, and empty when it has not. [param payload] arrives in the shape [method receive] draws, for the matching [param kind].

method.name: local_signaler_id
method.description: The address other peers reach this signaler at, as the signaler itself reports it.

method.name: receive
method.description: Reports one inbound offer, answer or ICE bundle from [param from_peer], whose signaling address is [param from_address]. A signaler that can receive the same message twice is expected to report it once, because the session applies what it is given. Which keys [param payload] carries is decided by [param kind]. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴offer / answer ┃ ┠╴type String "offer" or "answer" ┃ ┠╴sdp String the local session description ┃ ┠╴candidates Array[Dictionary] every candidate gathered so far, each ┃ ┃ shaped like the candidate case below ┃ ┖╴is_local bool true when both ends of this handshake ┃ run in the same process ┖╴candidate ┠╴type String "candidate" ┠╴candidate String the ICE candidate line ┠╴sdpMid String the media stream this candidate belongs to ┖╴sdpMLineIndex int the media line index this candidate belongs to [/codeblock]

method.name: report_lost
method.description: Reports that signaling was open and has gone away. A client that has not yet reached its host treats this as a stalled join.

method.name: report_ready
method.description: Reports that at least one signaling route is usable. Reporting this more than once is harmless.

method.name: report_unreachable
method.description: Reports that no signaling route could be opened at all.
